sn46.53:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍaya pavisiṃsu || || 3--10.
sn46.53:2.1: Evam vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā || ||
sn46.53:2.2: Yasmim āvuso samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti || katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānam akālo bhāvanāya || katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānam kālo bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:2.3: Yasmim panāvuso samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti || katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānam akālo bhāvanāya || katamesam tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāyā ti || ||
sn46.53:2.4: Evam puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti uttariṃ ca vighātam āpajjissanti || || 12.
sn46.53:3.1: Nāhaṃ tam bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sasamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesam pañhānaṃ veyyakāraṇena cittam ārādheyya aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā || || 13.
sn46.53:4.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti || akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya akālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:4.3: līnam bhikkhave cittam tam etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti || || 14.
sn46.53:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso parittam aggim ujjāletukāmo assa ||
sn46.53:5.2: So tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya allāni ca kaṭṭhani pakkhipeyya udakavātañca dadeyya paṃsukāna ca okireyya
sn46.53:5.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittam aggim ujjāletuṃ || ||
sn46.53:6.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittam hoti || akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:6.3: līnam bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti || || 15.
sn46.53:7.1: Yasmiṃ ca kho bhikkhave samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti || kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya kālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:7.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti || || 16.
sn46.53:8.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso parittam aggim ujjāletukāmo assa ||
sn46.53:8.2: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya sukkhāni gomayāni pakkhipeyya sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya || mukhavātañca dadeyya na ca paṃsukena okireyya ||
sn46.53:8.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittam aggim ujjāletun ti || ||
sn46.53:9.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti || kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:9.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti || || 17.
sn46.53:10.1: Yasmim bhikkhave samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti || akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya ||
sn46.53:10.3: uddhatam bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti || || 18.
sn46.53:11.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahantam aggikhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa ||
sn46.53:11.2: so tattha sukkhāni ceva teṇāni pakkhipeyya sukkhāni gomayāni pakkhipeyya sukkhānī ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya mukhavātañca dadeyya na ca paṃsukena okireyya ||
sn46.53:11.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantam aggikhandhaṃ nibbāpetun ti || ||
sn46.53:12.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti || akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:12.3: uddhatam bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayam hoti || || 19.
sn46.53:13.1: Yasmiṃ ca kho bhikkhave samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti || kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:13.3: uddhatam bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti || || 20.
sn46.53:14.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahantam aggikhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa ||
sn46.53:14.2: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya- allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya udakavātañ ca dadeyya || paṃsukena ca okireyya ||
sn46.53:14.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantam aggikhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti || ||
sn46.53:15.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yasmim samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti || kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || kālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya || ||
sn46.53:15.3: uddhatam bhikkhave cittaṃ tam etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti || || 21.
sn46.53:15.4: Satim ca kvāham bhikkhave sabbatthikaṃ vadāmīti || || 54. (4)
